name: prest-guard
description: prest-guard - pREST middleware plugin: opt-in API security middleware for pREST (PostgreSQL REST), powered by the guard-core Go engine

paragraphs: Guard Core is the Python engine. Framework adapters are thin wrappers that translate native request/response types into Guard Core's protocols. The telemetry agents ship security events and metrics to the monitoring backend. Parallel engine implementations exist for Go, PHP, TypeScript (on npm), and Rust (on crates.io) - all ports of the same reference semantics, conformance-tested against the shared adversarial corpus.
features: Rate limiting per client IP with Redis-shared state
IP policy: blacklist, whitelist, and exemptions
Payload inspection across 19 attack categories, bounded by a measured default body budget
Strict fail-closed config: every raw value validated, invalid config is a loud error
